newsitem.title: USA: IMF approves $657 million loan for Bulgaria.
newsitem.headline: IMF approves $657 million loan for Bulgaria.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund on Friday approved $657 million for Bulgaria to support moves by the country to a market economy and to make up for a decline in cereal yields.

The IMF said that $509 million is available over the next 14 months under a standby credit to support the government's economic goals while the remainder will go to make up for declines in the yield of cereals.
The standby credit supports "a break with the past and aims to restore confidence in public institutions and to put Bulgaria firmly on the path to a market economy," the lending institution said.
